messages:
soren: Heads-up team — target publish is Tue 09:00 PT. We need final changelog permalink, canonical docs URL, staging preview, and social screenshots by EOD today. Also want a single hero stat for the blog.

anya: Ill draft the hero and the short benchmark narrative. Can we pick one clean metric? Derek, last perf run had a range.

derek: Short answer: p95 web workloads show 28-42% per-token cost savings depending on sequence length. Recommend using "up to 42%" on the hero and then qualify with "on typical web workloads" in the subhead. Full appendix link in docs.

michelle: For inbound routing: we should surface two CTAs on the page — general webinar signup + enterprise trial. Enterprise leads should auto-tag hubspot with "sales:enterprise". Can ops confirm hidden fields?
derek: Ill wire the hidden fields and UTM params. Use utm_source=announce, utm_campaign=release-1.3, hidden field sales_tier=enterprise.

soren: Good. Also planning two email variants for PLG vs enterprise. Michelle, can you prepare copy A/B?

michelle: Yep. Variant A (PLG) leans on the cost stat and self-serve CTA; Variant B (enterprise) highlights Dedicated fallback routing and SLA language. Ill attach both to the calendar invite.

anya: Draft hero: "Up to 42% lower per-token costs on typical web workloads." Subhead: "Adaptive batching, new quantization profiles, and smarter routing reduce unit economics with no prompt changes." Will add footnote linking to perf appendix.

derek: Changelog PR merged -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/releases/tag/v1.3 (draft release created). Adding migration note for dedicated configs.

deploy-bot: preview deploy started: refs/heads/release-1.3 -> staging-preview. build id: a1b2c3. Preview URL will be posted after successful build.

soren: Need preview URL for social card screenshots ASAP so design can export OG images. Also confirm webinar CTA goes to the registration modal and hooks to HubSpot list "webinar-release-1-3".

derek: Preview live: https://staging-preview.redwood.ai/releases/1.3 (expires in 7 days). I added the hidden fields and UTM support.

michelle: HubSpot mapping confirmed. Webinar set for Tue 11:00 PT, co-hosted with partner Acme AI; registration form tags partner source when selected.

anya: Ill write the benchmark blurb for the blog and the longer appendix for docs. Suggest sentence: "In internal benchmarks on a representative web workload suite, v1.3 reduced per-token unit cost by up to 42% via adaptive batching and quantization-aware execution paths; see full methodology in the appendix."

soren: Love that. Two last things: 1) press embargo window — marketing wants a noon embargo lift same day, 2) schedule the newsroom RSS card to publish with the announce. Derek, can we queue the canary?

derek: Canary rollout scheduled Wed 08:45 PT, 10% initial traffic. Rollback autonomous if p95 latency regresses >10% for 15m. Command used: `deployctl rollout start --env=prod --tag=v1.3 --canary=10% --watch`.

michelle: Ill prepare the social copy variations and the co-host shoutouts. Also prepping the webinar deck and a short script for the demo focusing on the cost/latency tradeoffs.

soren: Checklist recap: changelog (derek) ✅, docs canonical (anya) pending link, preview (derek) ✅, webinar signup (michelle) ✅, hero copy (anya) ✅, social screenshots (design) pending. If docs permalink lands before 5pm were green to schedule.

derek: Docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/release-1.3 and perf appendix at https://docs.redwood.ai/reports/batching-v1.3.

soren: Perfect — scheduling announce for 09:00 PT and webinar for 11:00 PT. Ill post the queued publish URLs and the email send windows here. Thanks all! :tada:
